visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: replace with a Pattern Instead of split and a Loop
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The text is split at every space, the empty pieces are removed in a loop, and the words are joined again. Collapse the spaces with one replace. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: \s+ matches a whole run of spaces at once, so splitting, filtering out empty pieces and joining are replaced by a single call.
